name: Trundle · Gremlet #39
description:
A tread-wheeled machine with a mushroom growing on its head. It drives very carefully so the mushroom doesn't fall.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Trundle in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
